detail.longDescription: So the # technology crowd is positively boiling over with uncaught crimes, just like Republican and other # conservative political circles invariably attract the swindlers and the sex pests and other abusers of power. The politicians hope they can tamper with government so as to make their crimes retroactively legitimate, and the # programming elitists hope to do the same with technology , using the anonymity of Internet communications as their chief shield against detection and investigation of their crimes. At some point the high-tech crowd is gonna have to grapple with the sad truth: not a one of you, not if you're of any power or influence in the world of technology, has a moral leg to stand on. You're all guilty of unconscionable abuses and profiting from genocides and all the corporate sins in the catalogue. ~Chara of Pnictogen
